correctness.rationale: At position t in Z_n the symbol is a_{1+nu_2(t)}. Every Z_m occurrence begins at residue 1 mod 2^m. The continuation set of a proper prefix is one letter except for exact Z_m prefixes where all higher-ranked center letters can follow; border lengths of Z_s are exactly 2^m−1. Induct on n via the unique a_n: old minimal absent words persist; a word with two a_n occurrences must have them as endpoints enclosing a border Z_m; with one a_n it cannot appear internally as the unique occurrence permits context gluing, so endpoint continuations exactly generate a_n Z_m a_j and their reversals. This proves exhaustiveness and counting across all n. An independent suffix/prefix factor oracle constructed actual Z_n and compared full sets for n=1..7 (counts 1,3,8,18,35,61,98), not merely predicted totals; the proof rather than these finite checks establishes all-rank result.

final_claim: For the finite Zimin words Z_0=empty and Z_n=Z_{n-1}a_nZ_{n-1} over the exact n-letter alphabet, the full set of minimal absent contiguous words is the disjoint union over m=0..n−1 of a_{m+1}Z_ma_{m+1} and a_iZ_ma_j with m+2<=i,j<=n. Thus multiplicities at length 2^m+1 are 1+(n−m−1)^2 and the total is n+n(n−1)(2n−1)/6.
